title: Vagus Nerve Immunohistochemistry Protocol
author: J. Ashley Ezzell
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bwuwpexe
materials: biotinylated SP-conjugated Affinipure goat anti-rabbit antibody
Dehydrate, clear, and coverslip using DPX mountant.

steps.title: Bake and Cool Slides
steps.instruction: Bake slides containing paraffin-embedded vagus nerve sections overnight at 50°C, then cool overnight.

steps.title: Deparaffinize and Hydrate Slides
steps.instruction: Deparaffinize the slides and hydrate them to distilled water using the following sequence:

steps.title: Perform Heat-Induced Epitope Retrieval (HIER)
steps.instruction: Perform HIER using a buffer with pH 6.0 (Thermo, TA-135-HBL) with a specific temperature profile.

substeps.instruction: Cool for 20 min at room temperature

steps.title: Block Endogenous Peroxidase
steps.instruction: Block the sections using 3% H2O2 diluted in deionized water for 10 min.

steps.title: Protein Blocking
steps.instruction: Block the sections using DAKO Protein Block (X0909) for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Apply rabbit anti-tyrosine hydroxylase primary antibody (Abcam, ab112) diluted 1:250 in Thermo Antibody Diluent and incubate overnight at 4°C.

substeps.instruction: Rinse in Tris Tween buffer (2x 2 min)

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Apply biotinylated SP-conjugated Affinipure goat anti-rabbit IgG (H+L) secondary antibody (Jackson, 111-065-144) diluted 1:500 in Thermo Antibody Diluent and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Rinse in Tris Tween buffer (2x 2 min)

steps.title: ABC Elite Incubation
steps.instruction: Apply ABC Elite (Vector, PK-6100) at a concentration of 1:50 for 30 min at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Rinse in Tris Tween buffer (2x 2 min)

steps.title: DAB Chromogen Development
steps.instruction: Apply DAB chromogen (Thermo, TA-125-QHDX) for 3 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Image Acquisition
steps.instruction: Image samples at 20x using a Nikon Ti2 microscope with a DS-Ri2 color CMOS camera (Nikon Instruments Inc.).

substeps.instruction: Select the best of four slices per sample based on quality (no tearing or fraying)
